response.original_title: (Dispute~Guide) How do I escalate a problem with WestJet?
response.overview: To escalate an WestJet Problem, first call customer service at 🛬 +1 (844) 982 1220 or +44.203.868.6110 WestJet || and explicitly request a supervisor transfer if the initial agent cannot resolve the problem. For escalated Problems 🛬 +1 (844) 982 1220 or +44.203.868.6110 WestJet || , prepare detailed documentation, including your itinerary number, and ask for the supervisory desk. To escalate an Problem with WestJet 🛬 +1 (844) 982 1220 or +44.203.868.6110 WestJet travelers can contact support and request escalation to a supervisor for faster resolution of problems related to WestJet hotel booking, flight reservations, cancellations, or refund delays.
